title: Naturality of objectwise topological cohomology comparison
statement: Let f:Z -> X be continuous and assume its direct image on abelian sheaves is additive [def-sp-left-exact-additive]. Let KX and KZ be the free abelian terminal sheaves, and H_X^p and H_Z^p the canonical Ext cohomology functors [def-sc-topological-abelian-cohomology]. Let a:KX -> f_*KZ send each sheafification generator h to f^{-1}(h) followed by the terminal-open equality. Suppose additive maps tau_{p,F}:H_X^p(f_*F) -> H_Z^p(F) are given for all p,F and satisfy the resolution-cocycle formula: for all injective resolutions I of F and J of f_*F, all comparisons phi:J -> f_*I over f_*F, and all cycles s,z with a composed with f_*z = s composed with phi^p, tau_{p,F}(J.extMk(s))=I.extMk(z). Then for each coefficient morphism g:F -> G and each p, H_X^p(f_*g) followed by tau_{p,G} equals tau_{p,F} followed by H_Z^p(g). This statement constructs no maps.

source.place: Derived Categories, Lemmas 13.18.6 and 13.18.7; with the cohomology definition of Tag 01DZ and terminal-section identity of the proof of Tag 01EZ

proof.text:
Represent a class by a cocycle in a resolution J of f_*F. Lift any coefficient
map g:F -> G to a map between injective resolutions I and I' and lift f_*g between
J and J'. Choose comparisons J -> f_*I and J' -> f_*I'. The two composites from J
into f_*I' extend the same augmentation map and are homotopic, because f_*I' is
termwise injective. Their global-section maps therefore agree on cohomology.
As a sends the generators to terminal-section generators, precomposition
z maps to a >> f_*z is a bijection Hom(KZ,T) -> Hom(KX,f_*T), natural in T.
Thus for each comparison and source cycle there exists a unique matching z;
the bijection commutes with differentials, so z is a cycle. Apply the formula
for tau to these matching cycles. The Ext functor maps a cycle class by composing
with a resolution lift of the coefficient map (InjectiveResolution.extMk_comp_mk₀).
This identifies the two paths around the naturality square with the composites. Every Ext class
has a cocycle representative, so the
square commutes on every element; extensionality of additive homomorphisms gives
the displayed equality. This also covers degree zero and zero coefficient maps.
